Metadata.title: Makan | Modern Next.js Template with Cairo & Alexandria
Metadata.description: Enterprise-ready Next.js project with Tailwind CSS, next-intl translations, Cairo and Alexandria Arabic typography.

Hero.description: Experience first-class bilingual support with Arabic and English typography, fully optimized with next-intl, App Router, and Tailwind CSS best practices.

TypographyShowcase.title: Crafted with Cairo & Alexandria
TypographyShowcase.subtitle: Harmonious pairing of modern geometric headings and exceptionally legible body typography.
TypographyShowcase.cairoSubtitle: Contemporary Arabic & Latin font engineered for high readability in UI, body text, and interactive elements.
TypographyShowcase.alexandriaSubtitle: Geometric, avant-garde Arabic display typeface with pristine weights ideal for hero titles and branding.
TypographyShowcase.sampleHeadline: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
TypographyShowcase.sampleBody: High performance web applications require typographic clarity, thoughtful internationalization, and optimized asset delivery.
TypographyShowcase.weights: Weights: 300 Light, 400 Regular, 600 SemiBold, 700 Bold, 900 Black

Features.title: Built on Modern Web Standards
Features.subtitle: Everything configured according to modern Next.js App Router guidelines.
Features.i18nDesc: Full next-intl v4 integration with locale routing, static generation, asynchronous params, and automatic RTL/LTR handling.
Features.tailwindDesc: Zero-config lightning speed Turbopack engine with customized CSS font variables and theme tokens.
Features.fontsDesc: Zero layout shift with self-hosted Google Fonts for Cairo & Alexandria preloaded for Arabic and Latin subsets.
Features.rtlDesc: HTML dir attribute, flex ordering, margin/padding flow, and icon direction configured automatically per locale.

Footer.tagline: Crafted with passion for Arabic digital experiences.
Footer.builtWith: Built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, & next-intl.
